Hello! I really fell in love with your style!

These two are estranged childhood friends with a push-and-pull dynamic. They live in a small town that is haunted by ghosts and yokai, one under the purview of its local mountain god.

For inspiration, we can see them visiting a shrine for the new year together, facing each other on the shrine steps, walking through a forest in the mountain after dark while holding hands, or playing hide-and-seek in rice paddies at sunset.

⌛ Hayami (167 cm)
A scowling recluse who works at her family’s antique shop. Antisocial, resentful, and acts like an unfriendly cat. She's stuck in the past, and spends all of her time with antiques.
テーマ: アンティーク、時計砂、錆、古い写真、黒猫、降る雪。

🌱 Wakana (163 cm)
A smiling airhead who takes care of her family’s rice paddies and works part-time as a shrine maiden. Sociable, and acts like everyone’s little sister. She’s scared of living in a cruel reality, so she believes earnestly in god and loves others with an open heart.
テーマ: 赤い花（隣の花は赤い）、緑の芽、神社、米粒、彼岸花、タンポポ、少女漫画、春。
